subject: Post-call: PO readiness, marketplace interest & MAP checkpoint
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Elena Varga <elena.v@medixhealth.com>, MedixHealth Procurement <procurement@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: PO readiness, marketplace interest & MAP checkpoint

Hi Elena (and procurement team),

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and clear next steps. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) items so we have alignment on sequencing and owners: 

1) Legal review (MedixHealth) — you mentioned a 2-3 week window for initial review across SOW + terms. Owner: Medix legal.
2) Security evidence — you asked for SOC 2 summary + encryption details. We can deliver a redacted SOC 2 summary and a security addendum. Owner: Redwood (Hannah/Vanessa).
3) Finance path — you typically prefer PO in larger deals; procurement/finance to confirm whether card payment is acceptable for an initial pilot. Owner: Medix finance.
4) Marketplace channel — you asked whether listing Redwood on the Medix marketplace would change onboarding/payment flow; that is optional and may allow marketplace-based billing. Owner: Ben/Marketplace ops.

Attached is a draft MAP workbook with milestones and dates (MAP-draft-MedixHealth.xlsx). Proposed timeline (high-level):
- Week 0: Finalize MAP and decide payment path (PO vs card vs marketplace).
- Week 1-3: Legal review & security package exchange.
- Week 2-4: Finance issues PO / completes vendor setup (or card payment if agreed).
- Week 3-6: Onboarding pilot / sandbox; can start limited traffic under a paid pilot.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Can procurement confirm preferred payment instrument (PO or card) and vendor onboarding SLA?
- Can legal confirm target date for first pass (e.g., by 2027-08-23)?

Next internal notes: Ben, can you hold pricing for 30 days once we lock in the preferred instrument? Vanessa/Karthik — please confirm SOC2 deliverable details and whether we should prepare the marketplace onboarding checklist.

Availability for a short follow-up sync (30 min): 2027-08-11 10:00-11:00 PT or 2027-08-12 09:00-10:00 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-draft-MedixHealth.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Elena Varga <elena.v@medixhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, MedixHealth Procurement <procurement@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: PO readiness, marketplace interest & MAP checkpoint

Hi Hannah — thanks for the write-up and the MAP. Couple quick clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Legal: We can aim for a first-pass review by 2027-08-24, assuming we receive the SOW and your standard terms. We typically redline. Do you have a standard SOW we can review?
- Security: Our security team needs a SOC 2 summary (scope: infrastructure + datacenter controls) and an outline of encryption at rest/in transit. If you can get that over within 3 business days, we can slot the review.
- Finance: For deals under $75k we often can pay by company card; above that we'll need a PO and vendor onboarding. The initial pilot budget is $40k, but the full committed amount could exceed $75k depending on usage. Please confirm if we can start with card to accelerate.
- Marketplace: We're evaluating marketplace procurement for second-phase purchases. If Redwood is listed, our internal purchasing could be faster, but it depends on pricing parity and invoicing terms. Is there a marketplace listing fee or different pricing?

Also looping in procurement@medixhealth for vendor onboarding questions.

Elena Varga
Head of Procurement, MedixHealth
elena.v@medixhealth.com

Date: 2027-08-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: PO readiness, marketplace interest & MAP checkpoint

Elena —

Thanks for the quick responses and the context on finance thresholds. Short answers below and attached a SOC2 summary we can share with your security team.

- SOW: Attached a lightweight SOW template we use for pilots (SOW-template-MedixHealth.docx). We can tailor scope/term/lite-terms for a pilot to speed legal review.
- SOC 2: See attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — redacted scope + controls summary. If your security team needs the full report, we can discuss an NDA/signed data processing addendum.
- Payment: Yes — we can accept card for the $40k pilot to get started immediately while procurement processes vendor onboarding for a PO for the longer-term commitment. If Medix expects to exceed $75k before vendor setup completes, we can do a short-term credit hold (subject to approvals).
- Marketplace: No upfront listing fee for most partners; pricing is generally the same but marketplace billing may add 30-45 day payment terms depending on the marketplace. Ben will confirm the exact ops flow.

Proposed immediate milestones: 
- By 2027-08-13: Redwood to share SOC2 summary + pilot SOW (we will do this today).
- By 2027-08-24: Medix legal first-pass.
- By 2027-08-25: Finance indicates PO vs card and vendor onboarding ETA.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; SOW-template-MedixHealth.docx; MAP-draft-MedixHealth.xlsx

I'll hold the 2027-08-11 10:00 PT slot for a quick 30-min check unless you prefer the 12th.

Best,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Next steps & owners for MedixHealth MAP (pricing hold + marketplace ops)

Team — quick internal note following Elena's reply and Hannah's follow-up: 

1) Pricing hold: I'll place a 30-day hold on the quoted pilot pricing under deal MDX-2027-489. Status: Hold placed; I will update if finance asks for adjustments. Owner: Ben.
2) SOW tailoring: Hannah to send final scope; I'll draft minimal commercial terms to reduce legal friction (limit term to pilot duration, standard liability cap). Owner: Ben/Hannah.
3) SOC2 & security package: Vanessa, can you confirm the exact artifacts we should include in redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (e.g., encryption appendix, key rotation notes)? Target: deliver updated summary by EOD 2027-08-12. Owner: Vanessa.
4) Marketplace onboarding: I'll start the internal checklist for marketplace listing and note whether marketplace billing affects vendor onboarding. Attachment: marketplace-onboarding-checklist.pdf. Owner: Ben.
5) Finance ops: Karthik — please prepare the vendor setup packet and a draft invoice template to speed PO issuance. Target vendor setup in 7 business days after receipt of the SOW. Owner: Karthik.

Please mark items you own as complete in the shared MAP spreadsheet (link in HubSpot). I'll follow up with a short internal call if any blockers appear.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
